title: 第160章 天命之子立孙吴宣战道宗送人情第159章 林东神通成只身灭孙吴
content_zh:
孙鼠站在远处，心有余悸的看着眼下的一幕，庆幸自己逃的够快，够果断！
正当他愣神之际，一道熟悉的声音在其身后响起。
“孙宗主，多年不见，怎如此狼狈？”
孙鼠定睛望去，竟然是他多年前寻得的那一天命之子！
“你，你怎么在这？”
天命之子上前拱手，介绍道：“孙宗主，我叫牧野，看到宗主在此愣神，特来打招呼。”
孙鼠双眼微眯，上下打量了牧野一番。
令其惊讶的是，牧野十年前他还是炼气五层，而居然突破到了筑基期！
寻常炼气要想突破筑基，没个几十年根本不可能，如此速度不可谓是神速！
“那灵石矿脉的空洞都是你干的吧！”
牧野并未否认，点头承认了下来。
孙鼠苦涩一笑。
“你可把我们害惨了！”
牧野仿佛并不在意此事，一脸淡然的说道：“区区两座矿脉而言，不足挂齿。”
“你可知这天弃州未来将有大变！”
孙鼠摇了摇头，他并不在意变不变，他只想活下去。
牧野轻笑一声，轻轻摇了摇头，继续说道：“你们可知，你们的覆灭完全是因狐歌一人。”
“确实是因为他。”
“你们真是不知天高地厚，与一州气运所共济之人对抗！”
“连那两片灵脉都是因为狐歌的到来而诞生的，你们居然还想杀死他！”

孙鼠一脸吃惊，圆溜溜的小眼睛都瞪大了几分。
“你怎么会知道这么多？”
“我师尊告诉我了，我来此地也不是被流放，而是受师尊所托来给狐歌送一道机缘，好赚个人情。”
孙鼠怯兮兮的问道：“你师尊是何修为？”
牧野微微一笑，两个极具分量的字从其口中吐出。
“化神。”
孙鼠脸色巨变，恭敬的问道：“连化神强者都要讨人情吗！”
牧野点了点头。
“我师尊说过，狐歌的未来看不清，算不透，将来成就不可估量。”
“说不定人情会在灵界之时，亦或是仙界才能用得上！”
孙鼠心尖颤了又颤，化神强者恐怖如斯，竟然都能算到飞升之后的事情！
“这灵弃州，百万年之前并非这般荒凉，乃是万州第一大洲，只是突遭巨变......”
content_en:
Sun Shu stood in the distance, watching the scene in front of him with lingering fear. He was glad that he escaped quickly and decisively enough!
Just as he was stunned, a familiar voice sounded behind him.
"Sect Master Sun, we haven't seen you for many years, why are you so embarrassed?"
Sun Shu looked intently and saw that it was the Son of Destiny that he had found many years ago!
"You, why are you here?"
The Son of Destiny stepped forward, cupped his hands, and introduced: "Sect Master Sun, my name is Muye. I saw the sect leader stunned here, so I came here to say hello."
Sun Shu narrowed his eyes slightly and looked Muye up and down.
To his surprise, Makino was at the fifth level of Qi Refining ten years ago, but he actually broke through to the foundation building stage!
It would be impossible for ordinary Qi refining to break through the foundation building in just a few decades. Such a speed is not amazing!
"The holes in the spirit stone veins are all your fault, right?"
Makino did not deny it, but nodded and admitted it.
Sun Shu smiled bitterly.
"You've done us a disservice!"
Makino didn't seem to care about this matter, and said calmly: "For just two mines, it's not worth mentioning."
"Did you know that there will be big changes in Qizhou's future today!"
Sun Shu shook his head. He didn't care about change, he just wanted to live.
Makino chuckled, shook his head slightly, and continued: "Do you know that your downfall was entirely due to Hu Ge alone."
"It's really because of him."
"You really don't know the heights of the world, and you are fighting against the people who are destined to help you in this state!"
"Even those two spiritual veins were born because of Hu Ge's arrival, and you actually want to kill him!"
Sun Shu looked surprised, and his round eyes widened a bit.
"How do you know so much?"
"My master told me that I came here not to be exiled, but to be entrusted by my master to give Hu Ge an opportunity to earn favors."
Sun Shu asked timidly: "What is your master's cultivation level?"
Makino smiled slightly, and two very weighty words came out of his mouth.
"Become a god."
Sun Shu's face changed drastically, and he asked respectfully: "Does even a powerful person who transforms into a god want to ask for favors?"
Makino nodded.
"My master said that Hu Ge's future cannot be clearly seen or calculated, and his future achievements are immeasurable."
"Perhaps the favor will be useful in the spirit world, or in the fairy world!"
Sun Shu's heart trembled again and again. The powerful person who transformed into a god was so frightened that he could even predict what would happen after his ascension!
"This Lingqizhou was not so desolate a million years ago. It was the largest continent in Wanzhou. It just suffered huge changes..."
